understanding.goal_understanding: The objective was to navigate through every level and activate all goal cells. Each goal required the carried piece's shape, color, and rotation to exactly match the goal's requirements when stepping onto it, after which all goals in the level would be completed and the game would advance.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move cost one stamina, and reaching zero stamina caused a life loss and reset stamina to its maximum. Walls blocked movement, and blocked_directions had to be checked before every action to avoid wasting turns. Shape modifiers cycled shapes 0–5, color modifiers advanced colors in the order orange, blue, green, red, orange, and rotation modifiers advanced clockwise through 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270°. The remaining goal required changing the rotation from 270° to 0° using the rotation changer at [19, 30], but the episode ended before reaching it. Losing all lives would end the game.
